allowList.description: Requests matching these rules are always allowed.

blockList.description: Requests matching these rules are always sent for approval.

redactList.description: Custom information to remove from pages while a Claude agent is active.

value.description: Literal text, regex source, or CSS selector

flags.description: Regex flags (regex kind only); g is always added

scope.description: Optional URL glob limiting where the rule applies

guards.description: Built-in guard overrides keyed by guard id (secrets, email, phone, ssn, credit-card, ip-address, financial, dob, government-id, address). Managed entries are read-only in the popup.

disabledChecks.description: Check ids to skip, e.g. regex-us-phone-number

guardMinCertainty.description: Guard checks rated below this certainty are ignored (default 6).
